body: Yeat is officially coming to Fortnite, with a new trailer giving fans a first look at his in-game skins and emotes. The collab will also include Jam Tracks for “Get Busy,” “If We Being Real” and “Money So Big,” and is set to hit the Fortnite Item Shop on Oct. 15.
